naming_from_swatch_names.note: PANTONE is a THIRD-PARTY naming system. A name is evidence about naming — not a colour definition, not ownership, and not permission to redistribute.

findings: the file declares NO spot colour: every swatch is GLOBAL or NORMAL. It therefore contains no authoritative spot definition, whatever its name says.

the file carries RGB only — no CMYK, no LAB, no ICC profile. There is nothing here from which a print-accurate or licensed conversion could be derived, and none may be fabricated from a generic formula.
CONCLUSION: PANTONE exists only in a NAME STRING. This is third-party naming evidence, not a colour definition and not a licence.
